records.title: Recursive upper bound via closed-form tail
records.summary: Rewrite the sequence as 2 - 1 / 2^n, prove the closed form with simple_induction after importing Library.Tactic.Induction, then finish the inequality with ring and pow_pos.

records.title: Top-level unfolding before finding a closed form
records.summary: If a bound goal is attacked by repeatedly unfolding the recurrence at the top level, the proof state grows but the target inequality does not get simpler. Switch to a closed-form lemma first.

records.title: Traceable evidence citation
records.summary: Every reusable record should cite a repository-relative path together with either a local line hint or an explicit theorem name so later reviewers can reopen the evidence quickly.

records.title: Nonnegative tail denominator via pow_pos
records.summary: When the tail contains 1 / 2^n, use pow_pos to show the denominator is positive before closing the final inequality.

records.title: Parity shortcut with mod_cases n % 2
records.summary: For parity subgoals over naturals, run mod_cases n % 2 immediately and close both branches with the old parity helper imports.
